agents_page.check_type_ttl_hint: Each instance reports pass, warn or fail itself. Missing the TTL is critical.

agents_page.check_invalid_id: Use 1–100 letters, numbers, dots, dashes or underscores, starting with a letter or number.

agents_page.check_invalid_timing: The timeout must be shorter than the interval.

agents_page.identity_type_api_key_hint: The agent sends the secret as X-API-Key.

agents_page.protection_secret_title: Copy the secret now and configure it on the agent. It will not be shown again.
agents_page.protection_delete_confirm: Remove the protection? Cognit will call this agent without credentials.
